title: Adaptive Confidence Sets for Nonparametric Density Estimation under Local Differential Privacy
summary: In nonparametric density estimation without privacy constraints, it is known that a confidence set whose coverage holds uniformly over a `rough' class of regularity $r\geq0$ can simultaneously attain, in $L^2$-diameter, the minimax rate over a smaller, smoother class of regularity $s>r$ if and only if $s \le 2r$. We study such adaptive honest confidence sets under non-interactive $α$-local differential privacy (LDP) constraints.
